name: kolibri-control-station-foundation
objective: Rust-first self-hosted AI Factory OS foundation for Kolibri Control Station
release_bundle_scope: content hash over tracked release artifacts excluding release/manifest.json, release/final-report.md and release/artifact-manifest.json to avoid self-referential hashing
scope: Rust workspace with core, events, policy, proto, secrets, sandbox, telemetry, PTY and locald crates
Rust service skeletons for locald, control-plane, agent, scheduler, artifact-service and model-gateway
Tauri 2 plus React/TypeScript Control Station shell
Static public site and GitHub Pages workflow for kolibriai.ru
systemd and Ubuntu Frame deployment documentation
release, architecture, security, event, MCP and deployment documentation
factory thread bridge to Home and visible MimoCode server proxy threads

verified_commands.command: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test

e2e_evidence: crates/kolibri-locald/tests/e2e_flow.rs verifies health, agent enroll, heartbeat, task submit, task lease, task complete, artifact listing and terminal denial without approval/task binding
services/artifact-service/src/main.rs hashes payloads with SHA-256 and rejects artifacts without task_run_id
known_external_blockers: Docker daemon is not available in this local environment, so make dev-up/NATS/PostgreSQL runtime was not verified here
REG.RU DNS changes require an existing browser session and must stop with USER_ACTION_REQUIRED if login, password, SMS, 2FA or CAPTCHA appears
Production VPS IP for api.kolibriai.ru is not confirmed in this worktree, so api DNS must remain pending
GitHub Pages publication and live DNS verification require pushing this branch and enabling Pages in the GitHub repository
security_notes: No API keys or tokens are included in the release manifest
Secrets are represented by references and redacted values
UI does not execute shell directly
Terminal is disabled/gated without task-bound approval
Policy and sandbox abstractions default to denial for unsafe commands
